title: giant otter habitat simulator with Opus 5.5
author: JJBareaIsLeFather
selftext: I'm using Opus 5.5 to build a persistent and hopefully realistic giant otter habitat simulator with dynamic adaptable behavior with every otter being unique and individually simulated, so far there are 6 otters of individual age and size. It's still a very early work in progress and will be released open source for free when I get it to a more playable state. I saw these majestic creatures at the Providence Roger Williams Zoo a few years ago and decided to build this simulator based on that. Sadly during the process of working on this I learned those giant otters at Roger Williams Zoo died and they no longer have any on display. RIP.
